atoms.text: The blue whale is the largest mammal on earth. The average adult blue whale is about 30 metres long! That’s twice as long as a bus. Blue whales’ main food is krill, and they live in all oceans except for the Arctic Ocean. They are often found in the warm waters off the coast of southern California and Mexico. It is important to learn about the world around us and appreciate all living things.
